new_today_news.headline: Blue Biofuels increases hand holdings to grow biofuel feedstock
new_today_news.summary: Blue Biofuels has leased an additional 167 acres of farmland in southwest Florida to grow king grass for bioethanol and sustainable aviation fuel production via its cellulose-to-sugar process.

new_today_news.headline: Full-Service Restaurant Employment Remains 165,000 Jobs Below Pre-Pandemic Levels
new_today_news.summary: According to the National Restaurant Association's November 2026 update, full-service restaurant employment in September 2026 was approximately 165,000 jobs (3%) below February 2020 pre-pandemic levels, while the industry is projected to add more than 100,000 jobs in 2026 reaching 15.8 million total employees.

new_today_news.headline: Peoria says rainfall caused combined sewer overflow into Illinois River
new_today_news.summary: City of Peoria announced a combined sewer overflow event into the Illinois River following rainfall. The city is constructing projects to reduce CSOs during wet weather as required by Clean Water Act and CSO Consent Decree; residents advised to avoid contact with affected river areas.

new_today_news.headline: Japanese hotel operator to supply 30 tonnes of waste oil yearly for SAF
new_today_news.summary: Mori Trust Hotels & Resorts has expanded its UCO collection initiative to 24 facilities (22 hotels, 2 restaurants), supplying approximately 30 tonnes of used cooking oil annually as feedstock for domestic sustainable aviation fuel production in Japan.

new_today_news.headline: Toast 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry Survey: Inflation and Hiring Are Top Challenges
new_today_news.summary: Toast's 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry Survey found that inflation (27%) and hiring (22%) are the top two challenges facing operators, both up significantly from prior year. Despite challenges, 49% of operators plan to increase staffing and 48% plan to keep staffing steady over the next 12 months.

new_today_news.headline: Council Seeks Low-Interest Loan to Expand Wastewater Treatment Plant
new_today_news.summary: Dixon, California city council unanimously approved equipment purchases and authorized pursuit of Clean Water State Revolving Fund (CWSRF) financing to expand its wastewater treatment facility. The facility currently operates at 70% capacity with 21,000 residents; estimated project cost is $48 million for one new process train adding 1.4 MGD capacity.

recent_news.headline: Cincinnati Restaurant Group Abruptly Shutters All Restaurants
recent_news.summary: A Cincinnati restaurant group announced the abrupt closure of all its restaurant locations, adding to ongoing challenges facing independent and regional restaurant operators in a difficult operating environment.

recent_news.headline: Moeve Produces SAF from Used Cooking Oil in San Roque
recent_news.summary: Moeve's San Roque Energy Park has demonstrated its ability to produce sustainable aviation fuel using used cooking oil as feedstock, integrating UCO into existing industrial assets for SAF production.

recent_news.headline: India's First Commercial Sustainable Aviation Fuel Plant Ready at IOC's Panipat Refinery
recent_news.summary: Indian Oil Corporation is ready to commence commercial SAF production at Panipat refinery using used cooking oil as primary feedstock, ahead of India's 2027 SAF blending targets for international flights.

recent_news.headline: Renewable Energy Feedstock from Greasezilla: Brown Grease as Advanced Biofuel
recent_news.summary: Greasezilla highlights brown grease from FOG waste as a renewable energy feedstock, emphasizing sustainability benefits and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in transportation and shipping sectors.

backfill_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Biodiesel Policy 2025: Waste Grease Becomes Energy Gold
backfill_news.summary: Federal and state regulators are creating incentive structures for waste-derived biodiesel, including EPA's new RFS rule that doubles credits for domestically collected used cooking oil and California LCFS updates that increase value for low-carbon UCO diesel.

backfill_news.headline: EPA Develops Technology-Based Effluent Limitations and Pretreatment Standards for Industrial Categories Discharging PFAS
backfill_news.summary: EPA confirmed it is developing technology-based effluent limitations and pretreatment standards for industrial categories that discharge PFAS, with proposed rule for public comment expected in coming months. This may affect pretreatment programs at POTWs.
